caption: Spicy red glossy broth with noodles and bean sprouts, green onions, in a white ceramic bowl with blue cartoon characters and red rim. Set on a dark wooden table with grain patterns and subtle reflections.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections near the bowl's edge.
The spicy broth is vibrant red, glossy, and contains visible noodles and toppings like bean sprouts and green onions.
White ceramic bowl with blue cartoon characters and a red rim, smooth surface with slight residue along inner edge.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved bowl shape.
